summary: API key field hidden under crawling pixel noise; holding the eye wipes the noise away and each character decodes before it locks.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The key to display and copy. Changing it rebuilds the characters; the copy button reads the attribute at click time.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The key to display and copy; reflects the `value` attribute, or the demo key when it is missing.

keyboard.action: Reveal while held; releasing the key or moving focus away hides it again.

accessibility: The eye button has `aria-label="Hold to reveal the key"` and `aria-pressed` reflecting whether it is held.
The copy button has `aria-label="Copy the key"`.

The key container is a `role="group"` with `aria-label="API key, hidden"`, which changes to include the key once it is fully revealed. The characters and the noise are `aria-hidden`, and hidden characters are not rendered, so the key cannot be read or selected before it is revealed.
The hint line below is an `aria-live="polite"` region that reports copy success or failure.
motion: With reduced motion, the key reveals and hides at once, characters appear without the scramble and the noise layer holds still.
notes: The default value is a fake demo key. The key is part of the page: it is hidden from view, not encrypted.
Copy uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText`; when that is unavailable the hint asks the user to reveal and copy by hand.
The key stays visible for 0.35 seconds after release before it scrambles shut. The label text "API key" is fixed.

data.note: Pass your key as `value`. Without it the field shows a fake demo key.
